summary.headline: Codex 36: Indian Calculation
summary.text: Description of codex 36 (also 157 sup.), a fourteenth-century Milanese manuscript of 22 leaves with losses, including a fragment by Maximus Planudes entitled Calculation according to the Indians, the so-called Great, on the zodiacal circle, signs, degrees, and minutes beginning with Aries.
